summary: Profit & Margin Analytics testing completed (iteration 57). All 23 backend API tests passed covering: dashboard endpoint with all required response fields (metrics, category_rows, job_rows, customer_rows, trend_rows, low_margin_jobs, preferences), time range filters (30d, 90d, this_year, custom), category filters, widget preferences persistence, CSV/XLSX/PDF exports, tenant isolation, and authentication. Frontend testing passed: page loads at /reports/profit-margin via Reports navigation, metrics cards visible, filters working, export buttons functional, Simple View toggle and save preferences working, job profitability table with sort controls working. No regression on /financials page (loads with UI buttons visible) and /pricing-calculator/settings page (all 4 tabs functional).

GET /api/profit-analytics/dashboard.description: Returns metrics (revenue, profit, avg_job_value, avg_margin), category_rows, job_rows, customer_rows, trend_rows, low_margin_jobs, preferences

Dashboard time range filters (30d, 90d,.description: All preset time ranges return filtered data correctly

Dashboard custom date range.description: Custom start_date/end_date with range_key=custom works correctly

Dashboard category filter.description: Category filter restricts results to specified category (banners, vehicle_wraps, etc.)

PUT /api/profit-analytics/preferences.description: Saves simple_mode, widget_order, enabled_widgets - persists across dashboard requests

GET /api/profit-analytics/export (CSV).description: Returns downloadable CSV file with job profitability data

GET /api/profit-analytics/export (XLSX).description: Returns downloadable XLSX file with Jobs, Customers, Categories sheets

GET /api/profit-analytics/export (PDF).description: Returns downloadable PDF with metrics summary and job table

Tenant isolation.description: Dashboard data and preferences are tenant-scoped, unauthenticated requests return 401

Financial-role access control.description: ensure_reporting_access() requires owner/admin role or FINANCIALS_VIEW permission

Underpriced job detection.description: Jobs with profit_margin significantly below benchmark_margin are flagged as underpriced

Customer profitability aggregation.description: customer_rows correctly aggregate total_revenue, total_profit, average_margin, total_jobs per customer

Job profitability table sorting.description: Frontend sort buttons for profit, profit_margin, revenue work correctly

Frontend route /reports/profit-margin.description: Page loads via Reports > Profit & Margin Analytics navigation

Frontend metrics cards.description: Revenue, Profit, Average Job Value, Average Profit Margin cards all display

Frontend filters (time range, category).description: Time range dropdown and category filter dropdown work with Refresh button

Frontend export buttons.description: CSV, XLSX, PDF export buttons visible and functional

Frontend Simple View toggle.description: Toggle checkbox persists state, Save dashboard settings shows success toast

No regression on /financials.description: Page loads with Enter Daily Sales and Add Expense buttons visible

No regression on /pricing-calculator/set.description: All 4 tabs (Material Costs, Labor & Overhead, Category Defaults, Selling Benchmarks) load correctly

financials_backend_missing.issue: Financials page frontend exists but backend routes (/api/financials/sales, /api/financials/expenses, /api/financials/summary) return 404
financials_backend_missing.note: This is a known gap documented in routes/__init__.py as 'optional, low priority'. Not a regression from Profit Analytics feature.

critical_code_review_comments: profit_analytics.py uses LazyDB pattern for database access to avoid circular imports
ensure_reporting_access() properly checks owner/admin role or FINANCIALS_VIEW permission
load_dashboard_rows() fetches jobs, job_items, customers, pricing_configuration within tenant scope
estimate_benchmark_margin() uses selling_price_benchmarks from pricing_configuration to detect underpriced work
build_dashboard_payload() correctly aggregates data into category_rows, job_rows, customer_rows, trend_rows, low_margin_jobs
Export functions use pandas for CSV/XLSX and reportlab for PDF generation
Frontend ProfitMarginAnalytics.js has proper data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
Widget preferences are saved per-tenant in profit_analytics_preferences collection

success_rate.backend: 100% - All 23 profit analytics API tests passed
success_rate.frontend: 100% - Page loads, all UI elements functional, navigation working

context_for_next_testing_agent: Profit & Margin Analytics feature fully implemented and tested at /reports/profit-margin. Key endpoints: GET /api/profit-analytics/dashboard (with range_key, start_date, end_date, category query params), PUT /api/profit-analytics/preferences, GET /api/profit-analytics/export?format=csv|xlsx|pdf. Dashboard returns metrics, category_rows, job_rows, customer_rows, trend_rows, low_margin_jobs, preferences. Data is derived from cost_snapshot fields stored on job_items. Underpriced detection compares profit_margin against benchmark_margin with 10% threshold. Frontend has all data-testid attributes for testing. Note: Existing Financials page at /financials has no backend routes - this is pre-existing and not related to Profit Analytics.
